collision_boundary.C203: C203 has a fixed signed graph and continuous semigroup; C312 has a state-dependent confidence graph and synchronous nonlinear map.
collision_boundary.C259: C259 is a continuous tree Kuramoto phase flow, not bounded-confidence averaging.
collision_boundary.C301: C301 is an absorbing random partition refinement; C312 is deterministic metric opinion clustering with possible edge loss.

model.dynamics: synchronous average over all agents at distance <=epsilon
model.parameters: n>=1 and homogeneous confidence radius epsilon>0

nonclaims: No heterogeneous radii, noise, higher-dimensional sharp bound, or asynchronous update theorem is claimed.
Finite termination produces fixed clusters, not nontrivial primitive periodic orbits.
No target arithmetic datum, Euler factor, root number, automorphy, divisor law, functional equation, zero match, or Hilbert--Polya operator is asserted.

references.role: one-dimensional order/decomposition and cubic convergence theorem lineage

theorem_contract.cell_map: on each strict neighbor-graph cell the update is a row-stochastic rational linear map
theorem_contract.decomposition: a gap greater than epsilon persists forever and splits independent subsystems
theorem_contract.fixed_points: fixed configurations are exactly equal-position clusters separated by gaps greater than epsilon
theorem_contract.mean_warning: the arithmetic mean is not generally conserved
theorem_contract.order: order and coincident blocks are preserved
theorem_contract.termination: the system reaches an exact fixed configuration within 4n^3+2n+2 updates
